newsitem.title: UK: BOE says UK budget helps address policy dilemma.
newsitem.headline: BOE says UK budget helps address policy dilemma.

text.p: The Bank of England said that Wednesday's UK budget would help to tackle the current policy dilemma.
"The Bank welcomes the budget. It certainly helps to address the policy dilemma we are confronted with," a central bank official said.

The Bank noted in its last quarterly inflation report there was a strong divergence between the policy response necessary for the weak export sector, which was being damaged by the continued strength of sterling, and the response needed for the robust consumer sector.
The central bank's interest rate setting monetary policy committee is due to meet next week with a decision on Britian's 6.5 percent official interest rates due to be announced on July 10.
